answer: An adversary running 113 aliases hence needs 187 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Locks are written down in anchor, expire in orchard, and mesa lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 30 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 3771 identities would post 941 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
